statBlock.name: Master of Cruelties
statBlock.description: A Rakdos ringleader whose performances compel spectators to turn on one another.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, and lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Aura of Blood Lust. Any other creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. must pass a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure it immediately takes the Attack action and makes one melee attack against a random creature within reach. If no creature is in reach, it makes one ranged attack against a random creature within range, throwing its weapon if necessary.
Feed on the Crowd. When a creature dies within 60 ft., the master gains 15 temporary HP and has advantage on attacks, checks, and saves through the end of its next turn.
Magic Resistance. The master has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma is the spellcasting ability (DC 17). These spells require no material components.
At will. Charm Person as a 3rd-level spell, Crown of Madness.
1/day. Dominate Person.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee Spear attacks.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage when wielded in two hands for a melee attack. Either hit also deals 13 (3d8) psychic damage.
Captivating Presence (Recharge 6). Each creature within 120 ft. must pass a DC 17 Wisdom save or be charmed by the master for 1 hour. Its speed is 0 while charmed this way. Taking damage lets a charmed creature repeat the save, ending the effect on itself if it succeeds. A creature that succeeds on the save is immune to every Master of Cruelties’ Captivating Presence for 24 hours.

statBlock.name: Mind Drinker Vampire
statBlock.description: A Dimir vampire that probes memories and emotions. Mind drinkers often lead small cells and quietly watch their own agents for signs of betrayal.

sections.Languages: The languages the vampire knew in life.
sections.Traits: Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the vampire has disadvantage on attacks and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. In dim light or darkness, the vampire can take the Hide action.
sections.Innate Spellcasting (Psionics):
Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (DC 14). These spells require no components.
At will. Message.
3/day each. Charm Person, Hold Person, Mirror Image, Sleep.
1/day each. Gaseous Form, Major Image.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, at most one of which can be Bite.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Choose one willing creature or a creature the vampire has grappled, or that is incapacitated or restrained. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. Reduce the target’s maximum HP by the necrotic damage taken and heal the vampire by that amount. The reduction lasts until the target completes a long rest. The target dies if its maximum HP reaches 0.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature and the vampire has a free hand, it can also grapple the target (escape DC 13).
Mind Siphon (Recharge 5–6). Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a DC 14 Intelligence save with disadvantage if the vampire has already drunk its blood. On a failure, it takes 28 (8d6) psychic damage and the vampire reads its surface emotions and thoughts. On a success, halve the damage and reveal only its general emotional state.

statBlock.name: Mind Mage
statBlock.description: A Dimir operative who reads and alters memories. Many mind mages run their own cells.

sections.Traits: Special Equipment. The mage wears Spies’ Murmur, a magic item described in chapter 5.
sections.Innate Spellcasting (Psionics):
Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (DC 16). These spells require no components.
At will. Encode Thoughts, Friends.
3/day each. Charm Person, Detect Thoughts, Mage Armor, Sleep, Suggestion.
1/day each. Dominate Person, Mass Suggestion, Modify Memory.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Source notes: The printed score is Strength 10, which normally gives a +0 modifier. The stat block prints +1 beside the score.

statBlock.name: Nightveil Specter
statBlock.description: A hooded Dimir guardian that patrols on a Gloamwing and strips secrets from an intruder’s memory.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Mount. While mounted and not incapacitated, the specter is immune to surprise, and both rider and mount have advantage on Dexterity saves.
Undead Nature. The specter and its Gloamwing need no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Bonus actions: Mount. While unmounted and on the same plane as its Gloamwing, the specter can magically teleport into the saddle with its worn and carried equipment.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scythe attacks.
Scythe. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and 13 (3d8) psychic damage.
Mind Twist (Recharge 5–6). The specter magically emits psychic energy in a 60-ft. cone. Each creature in the cone must pass a DC 15 Wisdom save or take 22 (5d8) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, a stunned target can repeat the save to end the effect on itself.
Reap Memory (3/day). Touch one incapacitated creature and choose one hour from the past 24 hours. The target must pass a DC 15 Intelligence save or lose every memory from the chosen hour. The memory returns only if the specter dies within the next 24 hours.
sections.Gloamwing mount: The Gloamwing is destroyed if its specter rider drops to 0 HP. If the Gloamwing is killed first, the surviving specter becomes fixated on destroying those responsible. It can create a replacement over one month, during which the specter is incapacitated.

statBlock.name: Niv-Mizzet
statBlock.description: The ancient dragon who founded the Izzet League. From a private laboratory at the top of its guildhall, he coordinates research and gathers secrets in place of a conventional hoard.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Niv-Mizzet can choose to succeed on a saving throw he failed.
Locus of the Firemind. Niv-Mizzet can concentrate on two different spells at once. He has advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration.
Magic Resistance. Niv-Mizzet has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Master Chemister. When Niv-Mizzet casts a damaging spell, he can change its damage type to cold, fire, force, lightning, or thunder.
sections.Spellcasting:
Niv-Mizzet is a 20th-level Izzet wizard. Intelligence is his spellcasting ability (DC 26, +18 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Fire Bolt, Light, Prestidigitation, Ray of Frost, Shocking Grasp.
1st level (4 slots). Detect Magic, Magic Missile, Shield, Thunderwave, Unseen Servant.
2nd level (3 slots). Blur, Enlarge/Reduce, Flaming Sphere, Scorching Ray.
3rd level (3 slots). Counterspell, Fireball, Hold Person, Lightning Bolt, Slow.
4th level (3 slots). Confusion, Dimension Door, Fabricate.
5th level (2 slots). Conjure Elemental, Polymorph, Wall of Fire, Wall of Force.
6th level (1 slot). Chain Lightning, Disintegrate, True Seeing.
7th level (1 slot). Project Image, Reverse Gravity, Teleport.
8th level (1 slot). Control Weather, Maze, Power Word Stun.
9th level (1 slot). Prismatic Wall.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (2d8 + 9) piercing damage and 14 (4d6) fire damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d4 + 9) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage.
Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in the 90-ft. cone makes a DC 25 Dexterity save, taking 91 (26d6) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Legendary actions:
Niv-Mizzet has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of his turn. He can use one option at a time, at the end of another creature’s turn.
Cantrip (1 action). Cast a cantrip from his spell list.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 15 ft. must pass a DC 25 Dexterity save or take 14 (2d4 + 9) bludgeoning damage and fall prone. Niv-Mizzet can then fly up to half his flying speed.
Dracogenius (3 actions). Regain one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower.
sections.Roleplaying: Niv-Mizzet values invention, has spent more than ten thousand years studying the world, and quickly loses patience with people he thinks lack imagination.
sections.Source notes: The printed spell list places Hold Person at 3rd level, using a 3rd-level slot. The indexed reference places it at 2nd level.
